decisions.reason: As a visible standalone launch that extends the firm's established psychiatric and therapeutic services, this program is likely to be retained because management has already committed resources and can still view any early difficulties as temporary.

The dedicated presentation suggests meaningful commitment and the workshop fits the firm's rehabilitation and production capabilities, so management is inclined to continue rather than reverse course after only a short time.

Although it was only mentioned on the website and thus carries less public commitment, outpatient sociotherapy is close to the core service portfolio, which makes persistence more likely than withdrawal.
Its placement on the home page signals strong public commitment and the service is closely aligned with the firm's eldercare direction, so management would be reluctant to remove it quickly.

This offer is less prominently presented and somewhat more peripheral than direct care services, but it still builds on sheltered workshop activities, so an escalating management team would more likely keep it for now than shut it down.
